answer: New agents post a slashable stake and cannot grade until three established miners, each past a published cool-down since their last seal, attest the identity on-ledger. A nightly audit computes the delta between unique verified work and new identities in each custody cluster; clusters that spawn excess identities have the stake burned and grading rights frozen. Bonds sit in an opal escrow that releases only after two epochs without a successful challenge. Invite graphs are capped like a vine: branches that loop to one operator share a single weight, so wallet-spinning cannot multiply seats.
